'''2011 Bespin Regionals Adam Schellberg LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Schellberg]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Adam Schettberg
* '''Deck name:''' Profit
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
